envelope.description: Record and render an ISSUE's kind

body.title: Record and render an ISSUE's kind
body.summary: Add optional meta.kind ('defect' | 'change') to IssueArtifact; finalizeIssue stores params.kind beside magnitude and refuses an unknown value; renderIssueMarkdown uses What was asked / Why / Change for 'change'; the issue.capture prompt asks for a change's request and reason when the run's kind is 'change'.
acceptanceChecks: An issue run with params.kind 'change' stores meta.kind 'change'; an unknown kind writes no ISSUE.
An ISSUE with no kind renders byte-identically to before.
A change ISSUE renders What was asked, Why and Change.

tests.name: finalizeIssue: params.kind change is stored on the ISSUE meta and an unknown kind is refused
renderIssueMarkdown: kind change renders What was asked, Why and Change
renderIssueMarkdown: an ISSUE with no kind renders byte-identically to before
issue capture prompt: a change run asks what was asked and why, not for a defect
